Hymn 35: For the Strength of the Hills
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: C Major
Composer: Evan Stephens
Lyricist/Text Author: Felicia D. Hemans
Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 35 titled "For the Strength of the Hills" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in C Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Evan Stephens and the lyrics were written by Felicia D. Hemans.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
